pages.text: Use a Neon Prism on a frame of Onyx Blocks to make a portal to this city dimension. It is not recommended to have high render distance due to high structure count. Some shaders look *very* nice here but you may need to tweak settings if they try to show the overworld sky

pages.title: Obtaining the prism
pages.text: Neon Prisms are a 20% drop chance from Corrundum Golems in the caves of Prismacon, although the looting enchantment will raise this chance
